title: Loose stone samples tested in Israel turn out to be basalt

tellings.quote: And basalt, volcanic stones they found.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a treasure hunter, led a team that found an odd shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea between Sweden and Finland, which some have compared to a sunken craft. He says that loose stones taken from the site, starting around 2012, were tested in Israel and found to be basalt, a volcanic rock. He tells it as one of the puzzles about what the object really is.
